ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ عَدَدَ إِنْعَامِ اللّٰهِ وَكَمَا يَلِيْقُ بِكَمَالِهِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, `adada in`āmi ‘lLāhi wa kamā yalīqu bi kamālih.
en: O Allah, send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family to the number of Allah's bounties and as befits his entirety!

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى أَسْعَدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ عَدَدَ إِنْعَامِ اللّٰهِ وَكَمَا يَلِيْقُ بِكَمَالِهِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā As`adinā Muḥammadin wa `alā ālihī, `adada in`āmi ‘lLāhi wa kamā yalīqu bi kamālih.
en: O Allah, send prayers upon, salute and bless our Excellency Muḥammad and his Family to the number of Allah's bounties and as befits his entirety!

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى نُوْرِ الْهُدَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ عَدَدَ إِنْعَامِ اللّٰهِ وَكَمَا يَلِيْقُ بِكَمَالِهِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Nūri ‘l-Hudā Muḥammadin wa `alā ālihī, `adada in`āmi ‘lLāhi wa kamā yalīqu bi kamālih.
en: O Allah, send prayers upon, salute and bless the Light of Guidance Muḥammad and his Family to the number of Allah's bounties and as befits his entirety!
